identifier: The person examined the label on the particle bottle in use, 2026-09-19, and reported that it does not state a product identity.
grade_rule: E3, grade_tag operator_read. A value the operator read off the physical object. What was read is an ABSENCE, and that is still a reading: 'I looked at the label and it does not say' is evidence, where 'nobody has checked' is not. The distinction is the same one 4.3.1 draws for gaps -- looked-for-and-absent is not nobody-checked.
note: This is what makes the identification permanently open rather than pending. Before the label was checked, `AFR-0500-COOH` was unconfirmed and a look at the bottle might have confirmed it. The look happened and settled nothing, so nothing further is scheduled to arrive.
